supporting_pages.title: Explore BigQuery in the Google Cloud console \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: The BigQuery Overview page is your hub for discovering tutorials, features, and resources to help you get the most out of BigQuery.
You can use the navigation menu to open the following pages: Overview ( Preview ): lets you discover tutorials, features, and resources.

Go to Overview You can also open the BigQuery Overview page by entering the following URL in your browser: https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery/overview Review the following sections of the Overview page: The Introduction section: gives you a quick video overview of BigQuery's capabilities.
